name: Traks PRO Gear and Training
eyebrow: Industrial services · Dubai Investment Park, Dubai
headline: Traks PRO Gear and Training
lede: TRAKS PRO is the exclusive distribution partner in the GCC region at large for OEM/manufacturers and we stock their products in warehousing facilities over 10,000 sqft.
about: The company spans the Arabian peninsula, Southern India and employs 40 full time highly qualified staff. At TRAKS we pride ourselves in working with the best manufacturers in the field of climbing. The range of services is complimented by the different group companies that spans trading, training, services including design and installation as well as manufacturing.

From modest beginnings with one retail location and one distribution warehouse in Ras Al Khaimah in the Northern UAE, TRAKS PRO has established itself as the “go to” source for anything height for the whole GCC.
